name: Necromancer
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: Moderate Perception; moderate Occultism; high Str or Dex; moderate AC; high Fortitude, low Reflex, moderate Will; moderate HP; moderate accuracy, moderate to high damage; high spell DC. Abilities: Prepared occult spellcasting as a necromancer of their level; grave spells, Create Thrall (one thrall and Strike in same action), max cap of 3 thralls

notes.defense: Moderate AC; high Fortitude, low Reflex, moderate Will; moderate HP.
notes.offense: Moderate attack bonus and moderate to high damage.
notes.spells: High spell DC. Prepared occult spellcasting as a necromancer of its level: {maxrank}. Grave spells.
notes.specials: Create Thrall (one thrall and a Strike in the same action); at most 3 thralls.
